title: Shiftwave launch log — day planner and fallback checks (working note)
content:
Purpose and audience:
This is a working day-plan + checklist for the Shiftwave release (serving/runtime changes + routing policy updates). Intended for Release Conductor, on-call SRE, serving-runtime lead, and prod telemetry owner. Not a final playbook — use as the single source for the 24h launch window.

Scope of this change (short):
- Serving runtime: kernel selection tweak to improve small-sequence latency (affects Llama-variant and Redwood-quantized builds).
- Smart routing: new cost-priority routing rule added (latency-tier fallthrough to cost-tier after 250ms tail).
- Console: new per-model prefix cache metric and a small UI rollout for Toggle A/B.

High-level rollout phases (quick):
1) Dryrun (staging) — smoke + perf baseline (48h before launch)
2) Warm canary — 0.5% traffic, 15min observation cycles x 4
3) Broad canary — 5% traffic, 30min cycles x 6
4) Ramp — 20% -> 50% -> 100% based on gating checks
5) Afterglow — 24h attenuated monitoring and low-priority cleanup

Day-of timetable (hour-by-hour anchor) — D+0 (UTC times; team local adjustments allowed)
- 08:00 UTC — preflight call (10m): confirm roster, Slack channels, incident bridge link, runbook pointers
- 08:15 UTC — toggle staging dryrun switch; smoke tests (smoke-suite/staging)
- 09:30 UTC — validate telemetry baselines and alert runbooks loaded in Sentry/Chartboard
- 10:00 UTC — cutover window opens: warm canary -> set routing shards to 0.5%
- 10:15–11:30 UTC — observe (main checks listed below); if green -> enlarge to broad canary 5% at 11:45
- 12:30 UTC — midpoint sanity check; exec blip summary posted to #launch-ops
- 13:00–15:00 UTC — progressive ramps (20% then 50%) if gates pass; 30m hold after each step
- 16:00 UTC — final push to 100% if no red signals; otherwise invoke rollback plan
- 17:00–20:00 UTC — afterglow: lower-level monitors, validation sweeps, incrementally re-enable user-visible UI toggles
- 20:00–D+1 08:00 UTC — lightweight watch (on-call + serving-runtime buddy)

Quick smoke checklist (pre-canary):
- [ ] Build hash matches release tag (infra/builds #).
- [ ] Canary pool images deployed to region-us-west1 and eu-west1 (ops-helm/shiftwave).
- [ ] KV cache warmers enabled in staging and observed (prefix cache hit-rate > 60%).
- [ ] Perf harness (small-seq and long seq) ran; no regression >5% median latencies.
- [ ] Cross-region routing policy applied in staging and verified via curl test
- [ ] Telemetry pipelines (exporters) flowing to chartboard; sample traces show model-version tag

Telemetry gating (green if all pass):
- Request latency: 95th < 300ms for small-seq baseline on canary pool (compare to pre-release baseline)
- Error rate: 5xx < 0.05% (sustained across 15-minute window)
- Model mismatch/invalid tokenization spikes: None > 0.01%
- CPU/GPU saturation: GPU utilization < 80% on dedicated nodes; no OOM events
- Cost delta: per-token immediate spike < 15% (expected due to kernel change)

Alert channels and on-call roster:
- Slack channel: #launch-shiftwave (primary), #sre-oncall (escalation)
- Incident bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/shiftwave-2026-10-06
- On-call SRE: Marcus Liu
- Serving-runtime lead: Tomás Rivera
- Release Conductor: Aisha Khatri
- Product PM observer: Lena Park

Rollback decision matrix (short):
- Trigger: 95p latency > 2x baseline for 30m -> Action: throttle to previous routing policy (rollback staging/previous model variant). Page SRE and escalate to lead.
- Trigger: 5xx sustained >0.2% for 10min -> Action: Immediate rollback to pinned model version, scale down canaries to 0% and open incident bridge.
- Trigger: KV cache corruption or incorrect outputs (functional regression on eval set) -> Action: pull variant, revert quantization flags, start triage; if uncertain, rollback.
- Trigger: Observability pipeline gaps -> Action: pause rollout (stop scaling), fix pipeline, re-run canary when telemetry restored.

Runbook quick commands (ops cheats):
- Set routing shard -> POST /admin/routing/shards {"routing_rule":"shiftwave-cost-priority","percent":5}
- Revert to pinned model -> /admin/models/pin?model=redwood-llama-v2-4q
- Kill canary pool -> kubectl scale deployment shiftwave-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
(Owners: Tomás for routing, Marcus for infra commands)

Release notes (draft to copy into release email):
Title: Shiftwave — small-sequence latency improvements and cost-aware routing
Summary bullets:
- Reduced median latency on short requests by ~8–12% for Llama-variants in internal perf tests.
- Introduced a cost-priority routing policy that will prefer cheaper model variants for non-SLA traffic when latency budgets allow.
- New console metric: per-model prefix cache hit-rate and an A/B toggle to enable cache prefetch hints.
- Known limitations: small increase in per-token CPU cost during warm-up windows; some very long-sequence workloads see no improvement.

User-facing notes (short):
- No API changes. Responses will be faster for small prompts in most cases. If you rely on strict per-token cost accounting during heavy burst windows, expect short transient deltas.

Open items / questions to resolve (working backlog):
- [ ] Validate rollback script idempotency across regional clusters (ticket: JIRA-RELEASE-2387-subtask)
- [ ] Confirm observability retention for prefix-cache histograms beyond 7 days (Lena to confirm with analytics)
- [ ] Can we automate the 2-step canary (0.5 -> 5) via orchestration? (proto in github: infra/orchestrator/issue#63)
- [ ] Add a small synthetic prompt set to smoke-suite that captures tokenization-edge-cases for Llama-variant (Marcus)

Post-launch validation checklist (first 24h):
- [ ] Compare top-10 endpoints' P95 against baseline every 30m for first 6h
- [ ] Confirm no spike in rate-limited responses (rate limiter metrics)
- [ ] Spot-check 50 user sessions for degraded quality (sampled by evals-runner)
- [ ] Run nightly regression evals against golden prompt set (overnight job)

Notes to self / informal log (keep for postmortem):
- remember: if routing falls back to cost-tier, we MUST keep traceability so customer SLO owners can map tokens to model-variants. add extra trace-id header for 48h if enabling cost-tier fallback.
- quick wins: pre-warm frequent prefixes during slow hours (03:00–06:00 local) to reduce warm-up cost spikes

Appendix: quick reference links (prep):
- Smoke harness job: https://ci.redwood/jobs/smoke-shiftwave - Perf dashboards: Chartboard /dashboards/shiftwave-latency
- Git PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/446

If you're on the preflight call and something looks off: pause, take a screenshot of the dashboard baseline, post to #launch-shiftwave with the header "PAUSE: <short-note>", and wait for the Conductor to ack. No unilateral expands without two owners (Conductor + SRE) acking.

-- end of working note --

(Will fold into a cleaned runbook and final release notes once the dryrun completes. Prefer to keep this doc as the authoritative day-of checklist.)
